QueryString.value: SELECT Organization, Project, concat(Version, '#', toString(PullRequestId)) AS Resource, toDateTime(Merged, 'UTC') AS ObservedAt, Version, Line, Stream, if(ReleasedAt IS NULL, 'In progress', 'Released') AS ReleaseStatus, toDateTime(CodeFreeze, 'UTC') AS CodeFreeze, toDateTime(PlannedRelease, 'UTC') AS PlannedRelease, toDateTime(ReleasedAt, 'UTC') AS ReleasedAt, PullRequestId, Title, toDateTime(Merged, 'UTC') AS Merged, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(CodeFreeze), toDate(Merged))) AS DaysAfterFreeze, if(PlannedRelease IS NULL OR toDate(Merged) <= toDate(PlannedRelease), 0, 1) AS AfterPlannedRelease, if(PlannedRelease IS NULL OR toDate(Merged) <= toDate(PlannedRelease), NULL, toInt64(dateDiff('day', toDate(PlannedRelease), toDate(Merged)))) AS DaysAfterPlan, if(Created < toDateTime(CodeFreeze, 'UTC') + INTERVAL 1 DAY, 1, 0) AS OpenAtFreeze, if(OpenSeconds IS NULL, NULL, round(OpenSeconds / 3600., 1)) AS OpenHours, if(TimeToFirstApprovalSeconds IS NULL, NULL, round(TimeToFirstApprovalSeconds / 3600., 1)) AS HoursToFirstApproval, if(ApprovalToMergeSeconds IS NULL, NULL, round(ApprovalToMergeSeconds / 3600., 1)) AS HoursApprovalToMerge, coalesce(WorkItemTypes, '') AS WorkItemTypes, coalesce(WorkItemIds, '') AS WorkItemIds, if(positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(WorkItemTypes, ''), 'Bug') > 0, 1, 0) AS IsBugFix FROM ( SELECT Organization, Project, Version, Line, ReleaseKind, StartDate AS CodeFreeze, TargetDate AS PlannedRelease, ReleasedAt, multiIf(ReleaseKind = 'Roadmap', 'Roadmap', ReleaseKind = 'GoLive', concat('Go-Live ', arrayStringConcat(arraySlice(splitByChar('.', Version), 1, 2), '.'), '.x'), 'Untracked') AS Stream, if(Line = 'development', 'refs/heads/development', concat('refs/heads/', Line, '/development')) AS Branch FROM ( SELECT Organization, Project, Version, anyIf(SrcLine, SrcLine != '') AS Line, anyIf(SrcKind, SrcKind != '') AS ReleaseKind, argMaxIf(SrcStart, At, Src = 'S') AS StartDate, argMaxIf(SrcTarget, At, Src = 'S') AS TargetDate, minIf(At, Src = 'T') AS ReleasedAt, countIf(Src = 'S') AS Tracked FROM ( SELECT 'S' AS Src, Organization, Project, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Line, '') AS SrcLine, coalesce(ReleaseKind, '') AS SrcKind, toDateTime(StartDate, 'UTC') AS SrcStart, toDateTime(TargetDate, 'UTC') AS SrcTarget, toDateTime(ChangedAt, 'UTC') AS At FROM ADOTelemetry_ReleaseSchedule FINAL UNION ALL SELECT 'T' AS Src, Organization, Project, coalesce(Version, '') AS Version, coalesce(Line, '') AS SrcLine, '' AS SrcKind, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcStart, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(DateTime('UTC'))) AS SrcTarget, toDateTime(ReleasedAt, 'UTC') AS At FROM ADOTelemetry_ReleaseTag FINAL ) WHERE Version != '' GROUP BY Organization, Project, Version HAVING Tracked > 0 AND StartDate IS NOT NULL AND Line != '' ) ) AS R INNER JOIN ( SELECT Organization, Project, PullRequestId, Title, TargetBranch AS Branch, toDateTime(Merged, 'UTC') AS Merged, toDateTime(Created, 'UTC') AS Created, OpenSeconds, TimeToFirstApprovalSeconds, ApprovalToMergeSeconds, WorkItemTypes, WorkItemIds FROM ADOTelemetry_PullRequest FINAL WHERE Merged IS NOT NULL AND Status = 'completed' ) AS P ON R.Organization = P.Organization AND R.Project = P.Project AND R.Branch = P.Branch WHERE Merged >= toDateTime(CodeFreeze, 'UTC') + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND Merged < coalesce(toDateTime(ReleasedAt, 'UTC') + INTERVAL 1 DAY, now())
